title: kbingest's .NET global.json preflight checks only is_symlink, not git's link mode
goal: The .NET mapper's global.json preflight treats a global.json git stores as a symbolic link (mode 120000) as not a regular file, through ctx.links or ctx.readable like every other mapper read, so on Windows (core.symlinks=false) its note says not a regular file instead of not read; a test plants a mode-120000 global.json.

run: import re,pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/kbingest.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); i=t.find('within(folder, "global.json")'); b=t[i:i+600]; sys.exit(0 if i<0 or 'ctx.links' in b or 'ctx.readable' in b else 1)
